annotations.title: Race Fuel and Minimum Weight Calculator

description: Plan a race fuel load, reserve, start weight, and projected minimum-weight margin. Calculates from measured inputs without authentication and does not read or save account data. Assumes the entered per-lap consumption applies to race, formation, and allowance laps. Finish weight retains only the selected reserve. Confirm your series weighing rules and validate consumption with real data.
